The Chinese characters for Jesse

Origin and meaning

Jesse comes from Hebrew and means “gift”.

About the name Jesse

In the Bible, Jesse was the father of King David.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Jesse as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “gift”, is part of the appeal.
